ShareFile.title: ShareFile
ShareFile.description: Metadata and availability window for an uploaded file shared via a unique Share ID.

shareId.description: Unique share identifier used by recipients to look up and download the file.

fileName.description: Original filename of the uploaded file.

fileType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

fileSize.description: Original size of the file in bytes (up to 15 MB).

chunkCount.description: Total number of sequential chunks in the chunks subcollection.

chunkSize.description: Raw byte size per chunk before Base64 encoding.

durationMinutes.description: Uploader-chosen availability duration in minutes (1 to 43200).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the share was created.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp after which the file is no longer accessible.

FileChunk.title: FileChunk
FileChunk.description: Sequential Base64-encoded binary chunk of a shared file, sized safely below Firestore's 1 MiB document limit.

index.description: Zero-based sequential index of this chunk.

data.description: Base64-encoded binary payload for this chunk.

/shares/{shareId}.description: Top-level shared file metadata documents keyed by their unique Share ID.

/shares/{shareId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Subcollection storing sequential binary chunks for the parent ShareFile.
